title: Card replies can target one specific earlier line, threaded

steps: read card.js, card_reply (Assistant.js/Cards.js), Understand.js ClarifyCard precedent, Chat.js thread engine

design: card_reply gets an optional re (id of the earlier prompt/reply it answers); reuse Chat.js's existing Reply-thread rendering (built 2026-09-30 for chat-reactions, currently only wired for the universal chat-line shape used by voice sessions, never for a card's own type:reply lines) rather than building new UI

implement: Cards.js assigns messages an id (like prompts already get); Assistant.js's card_reply tool + method take re; card.js chat_line() passes re/thread through; Chat.js's reply() nests under its parent via the existing thread_item() when thread+re are set
restart Servex, prove it live: call card_reply with re on a real card, read it back nested, screenshot the AI board
set.outcome:
**A reply can now be tied to one specific earlier thing said on a card, nested under it instead of landing at the flat bottom of the chat.**

- [x] `card_reply(card, text, from, re)` — `re` names the id of the prompt or reply it answers; every message now gets an id. `Servex/agents/Assistant.js`, `Servex/cards/Cards.js`.
- [x] Renders nested, collapsed to "N replies" — the same thread widget the voice chat already uses, not a second one. `public/framework/ai2/card.js`, `public/framework/ext/Chat/Chat.js`.
- [x] Docs show the shape: [ai2 cards doc](/framework/ai2/doc/cards/), [Chat readme](/framework/ext/Chat/).
- [ ] Live proof on the running board — this session's shell tools were refused; checked by code reading instead. Needs a Servex restart; the recipe is in the task log.
